name: Home Assistant Safe
description: Least-privilege Home Assistant tools with entity-level ACLs and area-aware discovery.

url.description: Home Assistant base URL, for example http://192.168.1.30:8123.

tokenFile.description: Path to a file containing a Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token.

readableEntities.description: Entity IDs or simple wildcard patterns allowed for reads, for example sensor.*.

writableEntities.description: Entity IDs or simple wildcard patterns allowed for turn_on/turn_off. Empty means read-only.

blockedEntities.description: Entity IDs or wildcard patterns always denied. Block rules override allow rules.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for Home Assistant REST and WebSocket requests.

registryCacheTtlMs.description: TTL for Home Assistant entity/device/area registry metadata. Set to 0 to disable caching.
